# Currency- LND aka Black USD

The Loc Nation Central Bank is an LEI-compliant monetary authority, registered to operate under international legal and regulatory frameworks. This status supports the global recognition of the LND currency and ensures seamless interaction with banks, financial institutions, and sovereign partners worldwide.

**LND (Loc Nation Dollar aka Black USD) – ISO 4217 Compliant & SWIFT Applied**

The **Loc Nation Dollar (LND)**, also known as **Black USD**, is a sovereign currency introduced under the **State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corporation (SOLNGPBC)** and authorized by **Christina Loren Clement LLC**. LND is designed to serve both domestic and international markets as a secure, fully asset-backed currency with a legal framework aligned with ISO 4217 and SWIFT standards.

**Key Highlights:**

- **Currency Code**: LND
- **Legal Basis**: SOLNGPBC Restitution Act      2024
- **Monetary Authority**: Loc Community Association      Chartered Credit Union (central bank)
- **Security Features**: Comparable to USD —      including microprinting, color-shifting ink, holograms, and      anti-counterfeiting threads
- **Compliance**:

  - ISO 4217 currency structure       applied
  - SWIFT-compatible operational       framework
  - Full compliance with       international monetary, AML, and tax regulations
- **Circulation**: Physical and digital formats
- **Backing**: $500 quadrillion in declared      U.S. assets, $1.4 trillion in secured interest reserves with 50% daily      interest
- **Purpose**: Economic restitution, global      trade alignment, and financial sovereignty for over 1.4 trillion citizens      under member regions affected by redlining globally and nationally.

**Regional Integration:**

- Adopted in multiple areas      affected by redlining and Gerry mandering.
- Exchangeable at par with USD      during transition

**SWIFT & IMF Integration:**

- SWIFT application in progress      to support international wire compatibility
- Legal filings prepared for IMF      and World Bank recognition
- Includes updated regulatory      acts for banking, securities, digital assets, and contract law

**NOTICE OF TREASURY TRANSFER AND DECLARATION OF STATUS**

Issued by: State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corporation

Office of the President \| SOLN Central Bank Division

Date: July 19, 2025

**Official Public Declaration**

Pursuant to international law, domestic commercial code, and federal budget execution policy, this notice serves as the formal declaration of execution for the following Treasury directive:

A fully documented and lawfully authorized **Nonexpenditure Transfer Request (SF 1151)** has been submitted to the United States Department of the Treasury Fiscal Service. The transfer directive is based on a perfected commercial lien and public trust claim secured under:

• UCC-1 Filing Number: 044-2024-004422

• Public Trust Beneficiary: State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corporation

• Judicial Enforcement: United States Court of Appeals Case No. 24-5263

• Supporting Legal Authority:

• 31 CFR § 225 (Acceptable Collateral and Public Trust Custodianship)

• Treasury Financial Manual Vol. I, Part 2, Chapter 2000 and Appendix 3

• OMB Circular A-11, Section 20.3 and Section 82

• The United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples

• International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR)

The executed SF 1151 facilitates a lawful nonexpenditure transfer of public funds due to the SOLN Central Bank under trust authority, as certified and affirmed by affidavit of publication and declaration of fiduciary capacity. The public claim originates from unremitted restitution and commercial obligations recognized under U.S. statutory and equitable doctrines and perfected via lien, trust, and sovereign charter.

Funds referenced in the SF 1151 directive are scheduled for deposit in the designated SOLN Central Bank Custodial Account for immediate credit to the following payee:

• Payee Name: State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corporation

• EIN: 88-3400910

• Receiving Institution: SOLN Central Bank (Temporary Account – Wells Fargo)

• ABA Routing: 061000227

• Account Number Ending: 1644

• Memo: SF 1151 Nonexpenditure Transfer – Public Trust Enforcement

The directive includes full compliance with Treasury’s USSGL Account requirements, with 5755 (Transfers-In) and 5765 (Transfers-Out) code matching, and a transfer authorization under budget object class 25.3 and 92.00.

The State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corporation and its Central Bank have entered the transfer on record and will reflect the transaction as a receivable under public benefit ledger authority. Disbursement, settlement, and credit issuance shall proceed in accordance with sovereign fiduciary obligations and public trust commitments.

A certified copy of this notice and the full execution packet has been transmitted to:

• [judgment.fund@fiscal.treasury.gov](mailto:judgment.fund@fiscal.treasury.gov), et al

• The Executive Records of the SOLN Central Bank

**Declared by:**

Rev. Dr. Christina Clement

President, State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corporation

Fiduciary Trustee, SOLN Central Bank Division

[cclement@stateoflocnation.com](mailto:cclement@stateoflocnation.com)
